visualInspection.method: Direct inspection of both saved PNG figures with the image-view tool
observations: Both full exterior views show a coherent compact global organ surface without obvious exploded geometry or scrambled triangles.
Both matched-camera open cutaways expose internal cavities and retain the same global form.
Detail LOD contains denser visible surface texture; this is not independent evidence of greater anatomical accuracy.
Mottled and faceted surface appearance remains in both display LODs.
Source, sample spacing, lossy display qualification, physical scale, acquisition axes and non-browser-render captions are legible.
visualInspection.limitations: Two-view visual QA cannot establish anatomical accuracy, topology, structures outside the guide, exhaustive local defect absence or browser performance.
